about: Schema contract v2 between the local SQLite of twoody-server (« the Mac ») and the Postgres of the Twoody account (twoody-backend), 17/10/2026 (docs/schema-audit-2026-10-17.md, rule 14 of the root AGENTS.md). Every table of both databases is classified here: shared (`tables`, the same columns of the same logical types on both sides), local only (`local_only`), account only (`account_only`), or the same name for two different things (`same_name`, local only here and account only there). Every column of a shared table is in the table, or in `local_columns` / `account_columns` with its reason. `never_leave` says which rows of shared tables never leave the computer. Both repositories' contract tests fail on anything unclassified, stale or drifting. Changed in twoody-server, then copied verbatim to twoody-backend/config/schema_contract.json in the same change.

types.text: SQLite TEXT; Postgres string or text
types.int: SQLite INTEGER; Postgres integer or bigint
types.real: SQLite REAL; Postgres float or decimal
types.datetime: SQLite INTEGER, milliseconds since 1970 UTC; Postgres timestamp
types.json: SQLite TEXT holding JSON; Postgres jsonb
types.text_array: SQLite TEXT holding a JSON array of strings; Postgres text[]
types.ref: a row of the shared table `to`, named by its UUID: SQLite TEXT; Postgres uuid, the table `to` having its UUID column. `rails_bigint` (a reason) while the account still points by its bigint id: an open item of docs/schema-convergence.md, the account's test checks it is still bigint so the note goes when it is fixed

column_keys.local: the column's name on the Mac when it differs
column_keys.rails: the column's name on the account when it differs
column_keys.values: the values both sides accept, in English; the Mac's test compares them to the code's constant, the account's to the model's inclusion validation
column_keys.local_values / rails_values: what one side accepts while it differs, with `gap` (the reason, an open item); the test fails once the gap is closed, so the note goes
column_keys.to: for a ref: the shared table it names
column_keys.shape: for json: the shape of the value

reasons.@local_user: the person of this server (one per server, src/auth.ts), not an account id; a sync maps it to users.uuid of the account
reasons.@account_user: the account's user (bigint); the Mac's rows belong to its one local user
reasons.@account_pk: the account's bigint primary key, kept for its older foreign keys; the shared id is the uuid column
reasons.@bigint_ref: the account still points by its bigint id (open item: references by UUID on the account, docs/schema-convergence.md)
reasons.@hlc: hybrid clock of the encrypted history (vault) on this computer; the account gets one with the sync (step 5)
reasons.@vault_event: the row's last event in the encrypted history (vault), on this computer
reasons.@legacy: the cloud assistant of before September 2026, switched off (twoody-backend docs/legacy-cloud-assistant.md): kept, not extended, never synchronised
reasons.@legacy_identity: the « persona » of the cloud assistant (user_identities, legacy)
reasons.@candidates: memory_candidates is not aligned yet: the Mac's columns (content, kind, category, confidence…) against the account's of the old memory_imports (raw_content, proposed_*) — open item, step 5 of docs/schema-convergence.md
reasons.@event_address: the account's events keep their address in columns (address1… zipcode, address_id); the Mac has `location` — open item, step 5
reasons.@events_plan: planned on the account by step 2 and not done (source, external_id, calendar) — open item, step 5
reasons.@rails_internal: Rails, Active Storage, Action Text or ActiveAdmin internals
reasons.@account: the account itself: identity, sign-in, its own sessions and preferences
reasons.@relay: the relay and the routing between a person's devices and computers (sealed requests): the account's job, never data of the person
reasons.@vault: the encrypted history: sealed events and keys the account stores and cannot open
reasons.@circles: households and organizations, and what their members may share or lend: decided on the account (the owner's computer stays the authority on a share)
reasons.@analytics: statistics and opt-in diagnostics the account collects, never a question, an answer or a document
reasons.@legal: legal obligations: full IP addresses kept one year for legal requests (ip_retention_records), each disclosure logged
reasons.@site: the website: waitlist, downloads, visits, newsletters and campaigns
reasons.@billing: paid plans and payments of before (switched off: the account is free, User#cost_free?)
reasons.@local_documents: the documents stay on this computer; the same tables come to the account only when a cloud offer reads documents (step 4)
reasons.@local_graph: the memory graph (people, projects, places) stays on this computer until step 4 (docs/people-design.md: no synchronisation of entities)
reasons.@local_access: how devices reach this server (pairing, sessions, tunnel): a local mechanism, never shared
reasons.@local_mail: the mailbox read over IMAP or Microsoft Graph, kept on this computer
reasons.@local_bank: the bank statements imported on this computer: nothing of the bank goes to the account
reasons.@speaker: the household speaker of before (members, voices, faces, wake words): kept, switched off

source.gap: the account still says who made a project with the cloud assistant's words (Project::SOURCES): mapped with step 5 (user → manual, proactive and flow → learned, import → account) — open item of docs/schema-convergence.md

message_traces.message_id: the answer of this computer (message_ref and message_uuid on the account)

folder_shares.organization_name: the organization's name as the account gave it, for this computer's screens

discussions.cloud_models: a conversation with a cloud model (11/10/2026): those live on the account only, for now; a conversation of a walled-off project is never one
discussions.status: the state of an account conversation (clear-text path of before)
discussions.updated_at: the account's update time (the Mac has last_activity_at: open item, step 5)

messages.cached_tokens: the account's count of a cloud turn; the Mac keeps it per model call (model_calls)
messages.tool_calls: the tool calls of a cloud turn
messages.updated_at: the account's update time; a message of the Mac is never edited

message_traces.discussion_ref: the conversation of a trace shared as diagnostics, as the computer sent it (text)
message_traces.message_ref: the answer of a trace shared as diagnostics, as the computer sent it (text)
message_traces.message_uuid: the same answer as a uuid when it is one
message_traces.installation_uuid: the installation that shared them (desktop telemetry)
message_traces.created_at: when the account received the trace
message_traces.updated_at: when the account last changed it

memories.embedding: pgvector of the account's model; the Mac's vectors are in memory_embeddings (each side its own)
memories.entity_id: with entity_type, a bigint of Contact, Project or Address — open item, step 4

projects.archived_at: hidden but restorable, on the account; the Mac has none yet (step 2 planned it on both: open item)
projects.organization_id: a project of an organization (account only)
projects.slug: the account's slug; the Mac has none yet (open item)
projects.visibility: private or shared within an organization — not the same as the Mac's isolated

reminders.origin: who made the reminder on the account (step 2 planned it on the Mac too: open item)

events.origin: who made the event on the account

contacts.ref: the account's reference of an imported card

folder_shares.id: the account's bigint primary key: bridge_tasks.folder_share_id points to it; the shared id is uuid
folder_shares.host_device_id: the computer that holds the share, among the account's devices
folder_shares.grantee_id: the grantee, an account user (bigint); the Mac keeps it as text (grantee_user_id)
folder_shares.organization_id: the organization (bigint); the Mac keeps it as text
folder_shares.status: active or revoked, as the account routes requests; the Mac reads it from revoked_at
folder_shares.revoked_by_id: who ended the share on the account (a person); why is revoked_reason, shared

answer_votes.app: which app sent the vote (desktop, ios, android)

walled_projects.about: Jimmy, 14/10/2026 (docs/projects-design.md §8): nothing of a walled-off project leaves the computer — not to the account, a cloud model, another computer, a shared folder, the diagnostics or the warm-up seeds. A project with isolated = 1 and each row of the tables below that belongs to it stay here, whatever a sync, the account or an offer does; a conversation of a walled-off project is never `cloud_models`. Each path says how a row belongs to one: a column holding a project's id, or « column → table » for a row of a table that does. The future sync reads its rows through src/sync/walls.ts (leavingWhere, mayLeave) and its test calls test/helpers/walls.ts assertWallsHold with what it would send.

not_concerned.memories: nothing of a walled-off project becomes a memory (« Retiens que… » there is a project note: project_notes, local only)
not_concerned.notes: the person's notes belong to no project
not_concerned.contacts: the person's address book belongs to no project

local_only.document_folders: @local_documents; a folder of a walled-off project (project_id) never leaves (never_leave.walled_projects), nor does where it is beyond its path (identity: device and file number, volume: the root of its disk — migration 16, to follow it when renamed or moved outside Twoody)
local_only.document_grams: @local_documents (the Japanese, Chinese and Korean index, migration 9)
local_only.entity_relations: @local_graph (relations, 41 kinds); `kind`, `source` and `how` come into the contract with the graph (step 4)
local_only.file_actions: « Agir dans vos dossiers »: a plan that names files of this computer and acts on it alone
local_only.llm_endpoints: the model addresses this computer uses
local_only.memory_embeddings: the vectors of this computer's embedding model (the account's are in memories.embedding)
local_only.memory_entities: @local_graph (which memory names which entity, worked out on each computer)
local_only.memory_notices: the « Mémoire enregistrée » signals of this computer's chat
local_only.memory_pairs_dismissed: the « Doublons possibles » the person dismissed here
local_only.memory_usage: how often each memory rode on a message here, never synchronised
local_only.memory_vault_events: the encrypted history's queue on this computer
local_only.memory_vault_state: the encrypted history's state on this computer
local_only.model_calls: a model call of this computer (tokens, times, cache); the account's usage_events are quotas, another thing
local_only.peer_document_audit: the journal of what the other computers and the grantees of a share read here, shown to the owner: never leaves this computer (migration 8; occurred_at since migration 15)
local_only.project_document_digests: what each document of a project says, read by this computer's model for its overview (docs/project-overview-design.md): from the documents of this computer, and a walled-off project's never leave it
local_only.project_documents: the documents a project names, on this computer or a trusted one
local_only.project_notes: walled-off: the notes of a project (« Retiens que… » in a walled-off project), never in the memory and never leaving this computer
local_only.project_overview_versions: every version of a project's overview, proposals applied or ignored: read from the documents of this computer, and a walled-off project's never leave it
local_only.project_overviews: a project's overview (« Synthèse du projet »), each line with the documents it rests on: read from the documents of this computer, and a walled-off project's never leave it
local_only.share_guest_devices: the grantees' device keys this computer approved or refused: a security decision of this computer alone

same_name.account_computers: the same computers: the Mac's copy of the account's list, with what this computer needs to reach each (address, tunnel key, token); the account is the authority, nothing is synchronised, it is read from the account
same_name.auth_sessions: local: the sessions of this server's devices (@local_access); account: the account's own sign-in sessions
same_name.bank_accounts: local: accounts found in imported statements (cents, ms); account: the cloud assistant's banking (legacy, floats, bank_authorization_id) — the day one lives on the account: uuid and amounts in cents
same_name.bank_transactions: local: the imported operations; account: the cloud assistant's banking (legacy) — the day one lives on the account: uuid and amount_cents
same_name.devices: local: the devices paired with this server (@local_access); account: the account's devices
same_name.email_sources: local: the mailbox read over IMAP or Graph (@local_mail); account: the switched-off cloud assistant's Gmail
same_name.emails: local: this computer's copy of the mailbox (@local_mail); account: the switched-off cloud assistant's — the day a mailbox lives on the account too: uuid there
same_name.users: local: the one person of this server (@local_user); account: the account's users — a sync maps one to the other by users.uuid

account_only.archived_records: the account's archive of rows taken out of their tables (kept, never purged)
account_only.bi_alerts: @analytics (the admin's alerts on campaigns and spend)
account_only.installations: @analytics (one row per installation, from its own events)
account_only.usage_events: the account's quotas (the Mac's model calls are model_calls)
account_only.llm_models: the catalogue of cloud models (the Mac's own model addresses are llm_endpoints)
account_only.providers: the catalogue of cloud providers (the Mac's own model addresses are llm_endpoints)
account_only.feedback_messages: messages and answer reports sent to Osmove
account_only.organizations: @circles; organizations.uuid comes before an organization is synchronised (open item)
account_only.compute_grants: @circles (a computer's models lent to someone of the household or organization)
account_only.computer_authorizations: @relay (another device's access approved by the host)
account_only.push_notifications: notifications the account sends to the person's phones
account_only.queries: the clear-text conversations of before, frozen (step 3 of docs/schema-convergence.md); the apps copy them into the vault
account_only.responses: the clear-text answers of before, frozen with queries
account_only.steps: the steps of a cloud answer of before, frozen with queries
